Outline:
Purpose: Caelen assesses the shifting power dynamic as the masked man ignores the girl to focus on Scarface, prompting Caelen to silently recalibrate his protection strategy while maintaining physical vigilance against external threats.

Viewpoint: Third-person limited (Caelen).

Objective: Caelen observes the leader’s ledger entry regarding Scarface, noting that authority has shifted away from him. He must decide whether to expose himself to risk by drawing attention away from the girl or remain a passive shield, testing his resolve against the new hierarchy without speaking.

Meaningful Change: The initial shock of rescue settles into strategic patience; Caelen realizes the masked man holds the true power and that Scarface is merely an enforcer whose status is now precarious. He commits to being the "invisible" wall between the girl and any aggression, accepting the role of a silent guardian in a world where voice carries less weight than collateral damage.

Continuity Dependencies: Caelen’s hands are free but his feet remain unshackled; the metal collar is present and cold. The girl stands trembling beside him, no longer weeping. Scarface has moved behind the purple-robed man, altering the pen’s internal geometry. The masked man’s attention has pivoted from the new arrivals to Scarface, creating a brief window of uncertainty regarding the upcoming auction or judgment.
